title: A free portfolio graph cost nothing but gave few leads a line: decide by cost per usable line
hypothesis: Edges built from each firm's own portfolio page (firm, invested_in, company, in_sector) would give most leads a personal line for free.
change: Built the graph once with free HTTP, a no-tools model and a Jev check per edge, then walked it per lead (scripts/portfolio_graph.py).

oracle.baseline: Clay enrichment at its credit cost

result: Zero Clay credits, but only 10 of 309 leads got a line, because most portfolio pages are logo-only.
next_decision: Pick graph or Clay enrichment per job by cost per verified usable line, not by habit.
check: Before choosing a free route over paid enrichment, measure how many rows it actually fills on a sample.
scope: Investor lists where the personal line comes from portfolio pages.
